meta.title: Petri
meta.description: Amoeba oracle research and trading bots inside your DeepSeek chats.
meta.detail: Oracle research and trading bots in the chat. Research steps and bots appear as cards; a Petri tab beside the chat holds research and the oracle, and a Bots tab holds your bots, bots other people published and the leaderboard. Bots are made by asking for them in the chat, and each trades from a wallet of its own. The agent also gets Petri’s market reads and trade actions as tools, with nothing drawn for them. Uses your local Petri executable and workspace.
